recognize_zh: 一團漿細胞具偏心核與深藍色細胞質，細胞質內滿是紫紅色、細長桿狀的包涵物，形似 Auer 小體；左上方的嗜酸性白血球顆粒是圓形橘紅色，可作為對照，這些是含 Auer rod-like 顆粒的骨髓瘤細胞。
features: Cohesive cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clumped chromatin
Several nuclei show a small central nucleolus
Abundant deep blue cytoplasm with pale perinuclear zone
Numerous purple-red, slender rod- and needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods
Adjacent eosinophil with round orange granules and a crenated red cell for comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, small nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains numerous azurophilic, slender rod-shaped inclusions resembling Auer rods; these differ from the round orange granules of the adjacent eosinophil. The cells maintain a plasmacytic configuration without features of myeloblasts. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts show fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm without perinuclear hof and are MPO-positive, whereas these cells are CD138/light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Mott cells
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round, homogeneous pink globules, not slender needle-shaped crystals.
Crystals in CSH accumulate within histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and bland nuclei rather than within plasma cells.
